status: PROPOSAL — staged. Answers CCODE-83's explicit ask: 'that mapping is yours; I have not guessed it.'
note: The damage/soak TYPE mapping for the 18 traditions authored so far, plus the bestiary affinities that make it matter. PRINCIPLE: a type is the MEDIUM a craft works in, not its function-family — because that is what an affinity is a relationship TO. A thing that eats light eats it whether it arrives as a lance or a lantern.
designNotes: TYPES ARE MEDIA, NOT FAMILIES. `strike` is not a type — a marcher's blade and a rootkin's thorns are both `strike`, and nothing in the world relates to them the same way. `light`, `decay`, `sound` ARE types because a creature can plausibly be immune to, resist, or FEED ON them.

MOST TRADITIONS SHOULD HAVE NO TYPE, and that is correct. A marcher hits you with a weapon; that is ordinary force and needs no special relationship. Typing everything would make the mechanic noise. Type only where the world can plausibly have an affinity TO it.

TYPED SOAK AND AFFINITY ARE DIFFERENT THINGS — CCode kept them apart deliberately and was right. the_true_ground's soak layer is `type: deception` (it answers lies, transparent to a sword). the_bright_devourer's `absorb: light` is a relationship applied BEFORE soak. A ward that only stops one thing is not the same as a body that eats it.

deliberatelyUntyped.marcher: ordinary physical force — the world has no special relationship to a sword
deliberatelyUntyped.somatic: the trained body; force, not a medium
deliberatelyUntyped.wright: made weapons and structures — ordinary force
deliberatelyUntyped.cogitant: precision and insight, not a medium (the_single_stroke is a perfect blow, not an element)
deliberatelyUntyped.stillhold: consequence and presence, not a medium
deliberatelyUntyped.unmaker: ⚠️ DELIBERATE AND LOAD-BEARING: unmaking is not a MEDIUM, it is a RELATIONSHIP TO STRUCTURE. the_undoing_word already has its own cross-cutting mechanic (it unmakes wards/seals/pacts — checks item 6f). Giving it a type would let a creature be 'IMMUNE TO UNMAKING', which would break the one craft the catalog authored as the universal answer to bound things.

the_bright_devourer.note: THE AUTHORED SUBVERSION, now mechanically real: radiant and blazeborn crafts HEAL it. The valley's light-workers cannot use their own tradition against it — they must borrow another's. CCode's absorb-cap fix matters here: restored to its own maximum, never inflated past it.

the_unspooling_worm.note: it degrades structure; lattice's order-crafts feed its nature, churnfolk's chaos is what actually hurts it — an antipode answer authored into the roster.

churn_revel.note: the exact inverse. I gave it 'ORDER crafts suppress it' when authoring the bodies; this is that, typed.

the_ashen_wyrm.note: soak 9/rank 4 already makes it the endgame; resisting light AND decay means the two commonest damage types are the WRONG answer — which is what an endgame adversary should demand.

the_unmoored_choir.note: 'craft frays, memory loosens, the self blurs' — YOU CANNOT PUNCH UN-BELONGING. Its authored win condition was SHAPE (give it a true fiction); typed, that is truth/numinous.

the_gearfather.note: a pre-Transition machine: soak 8/rank 3 against force, but an enginewright who UNMAKES ITS DIRECTIVE bypasses it — the authored answer, typed.

the_bloom_that_hungers.note: it regrows unless burned — typed, light and decay are its answers, and rootkin's living-crafts FEED it.

glimmerling_swarm.note: manifested fiction — 'they wink out like the fiction they are'. A verist read unmakes them; that is what their zero soak was always describing.

erikCalls: THE KEYSTONE ADVERSARY — CCode is right to route this to you. The Cathedral as `immune` to every type but one is now expressible. His words: 'a strong shape and an UNFORGIVING one.' MY READ: the catalog authored it across FOUR traditions independently, which is a strong signal of intent — BUT a single-key lock is only good design if the key is FINDABLE, and the_whole_truth is a T-V verist capstone. A party with no verist has NO answer at all. RECOMMEND: immune to all but `truth`, PLUS a second non-craft route (evidence, testimony, a witness) so the lock has two keys and neither is a coin-flip on party composition.

Whether `numinous` and `truth` should be DAMAGE types at all, or ONLY soak/affinity types. They never appear on a damage craft — numenwork and verity deal no damage — so they may want to exist only as things a creature can be VULNERABLE TO. CCode's split (soak `type` vs sheet `affinity`) already supports that distinction cleanly.
